Tom (People Ops): hi @Rina. did you update your home country in Ripley and submit your NIE/empadronamiento before the vest date?

Noah (Payroll): thanks. If social tax documents and local enrollment weren't active by payrun cutoff (pr-20261001) it would default to US. We can request a reversal and reissue under Spanish payroll, but need tax residency evidence at vest date and external advisor signoff.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): high-level: Spain considers tax residency if 183 days or center of economic interests tests apply. Since Rina moved mid-September, residency likely not met by 10/1. That suggests US tax right may stand for that income, but we need to confirm source rules for stock compensation and any double taxation treaty relief. We'll consult external advisor.
Rina (Eng): ok — so probably won't qualify for PAYE in Spain for this vest. If US withholding is final, what's the remedy?
Noah (Payroll): remediation paths: 1) reversal and reissue if advisor approves (low probability if no residency), 2) US refund via amended return/credit for Spanish taxes if any, 3) People Ops/Finance can consider a short-term payroll advance if refund timing is a concern.
